services.name: Sailing from Northeast Harbor - Linda
services.desc: Available Times Available every day Morning, Afternoon and Sunset Duration 3 hrs Up to 6 passengers About The Friendship Sloop LINDA departs out of Northeast Harbor. Depending on wind and tide, your captain will sail around the calm waters of Greening Island and Somes Sound, the only Fjard on the eastern seaboard. We often cruise out to the quaint Cranberry Islands and East Bunker Ledge to see seals sunning themselves on the rocks. Get an up close view of the Bear Island Lighthouse and take a turn at the wheel or just sit back, relax and enjoy the most beautiful scenery in Maine. Available as a private or shared charter. services.name: Sailing from Southwest Harbor - Alice
services.desc: Available Times Available every day morning, afternoon and sunset Duration 3 hrs max. capacity is 6 passengers. About Depart our pier in Southwest Harbor and cruise past Beal's Lobster Pier and the U.S. Coast Guard station as the captain raises the sails and turns off the engine. If the wind is fair you could make your way up into Somes Sound, the only natural fjard in North America. Continue past Greening Island and the lighthouse on Bear Island. Visit a huge Osprey nest on Sutton Island and continue on to East Bunker Ledge to see seals sunning themselves on the rocks. services.name: Lobstering & Seal Watching Excursion
services.desc: Haul lobster traps, visit Somes Sound and see a seal colony. Shared or Private Charter available. Available Times Available Monday - Saturday Duration 2 Hours About Our wooden lobster boat, the Elizabeth T., was built right here on Mount Desert Island out of local cedar and oak. We carry up to 21 passengers on private tours and 16 passengers on shared tours, making it a perfect size boat for sightseeing and lobster fishing demonstrations. Cruise into Somes Sound Fjard and haul a lobster trap! Learn all about lobsters and how fishermen bait and trap them. We'll visit a seal colony on East Bunker Ledge and cruise by Sutton Island.
